demoStories.data: Kestrel Life & Annuity: steady ~$78K/month; forecast drops to $0 from Dec 2026. Reason recorded (SOW_END) with a note.
demoStories.shows: Top mover (largest negative); run-rate alert WITH reason; "Tell me why December dropped" cites it.

demoStories.data: Harbourline Financial: 3-month average $78K; December cut from $67K to $40K on Sep 20 with NO reason.
demoStories.shows: Run-rate alert "No reason recorded" + "Ask owner"; flagged in Tell me why.

demoStories.data: 10 T&M rows owned by TB / MR keep December equal to November, while 53 other rows dip. Last December (actuals) T&M revenue in NA/UK fell 14% vs. November.
demoStories.shows: Holiday flag on December; holiday reminder to TB and MR; history proves the seasonal dip.

demoStories.data: India rows dipped ~9% in Oct 2025 (Diwali Oct 20, 2025). For Nov 2026 (Diwali Nov 8) PN reduced the forecast; MR's Appian Factory row did not.
demoStories.shows: Holiday flag on the MR row for November; reminder when November enters the window.
